第012章 咱俩去登记？！
“你随我来，我带你去登记。”楚莹说完，便缓步向屋外走去。
“咱俩去登记？！哈哈，好啊。”岳雨猥琐的一笑，便跟在了楚莹的身后。登记这个词，让他不由想到了登记结婚。同时心中暗叹道：“若是谁能跟她结婚，那往后绝对性福啊！”
楚莹搞不明白为何岳雨会有如此的反应，不过看他一脸猥琐的笑容，就知道想的不是正经事。
跟在楚莹的身后，岳雨便对楚莹施展了探测术。得到新技能，岳雨自然是要试用一下。
叮！对方等级过高，无法探测出实力信息。
系统的声音响起。岳雨并没有意外，之前，技能上就写着，目前实力只能探测出三十级以下的生命物，也就是聚灵境以下。而楚莹则是开元境阶的修士，自然探测不出。“待会拿个低级的人试下吧。”岳雨心中想着，悠然的欣赏者周围的风景。
不久，开阳宗登记堂处，岳雨望着周围的景物，一脸的惊叹。建筑气势恢宏，周围的灵草鲜艳纷呈，小桥流水，灵气缭绕，景色如诗如画，仿若人间仙境。
长老讲道不久前便结束，此时，登记堂门前，门庭若市，热闹非凡。
山峰的青石道上，还有不少人前来，络绎不绝。
开阳宗，登记堂。是外门弟子登记身份的地方，同样还是宗门发布任务的地方，每天都会有数千的弟子赶来。
此时，最引人注目的便是岳雨，一个普通人，竟然会出现在开阳宗，而且身旁还跟着天才弟子，楚莹，想不引人注意都难。
数千的弟子，看着岳雨，眼神中有好奇，有鄙夷，有不屑，有嫉妒……每种眼神的面孔，岳雨都深深得记在了心中，眼睛是心灵的窗户，岳雨通过他们的眼神便可清楚他们的为人。
看到楚莹秀眉微蹙，有些不悦，众弟子便急忙移开目光，一脸若无其事的样子。
岳雨也不理会，跟着楚莹进了登记堂内。
见楚莹进来后，一名身穿青衣，面容清矍，周身散发着一股无形威压的老者便走了过来。神态恭敬，“楚小姐，好久不见，修为又精进了一些啊。”老者心中暗自惊叹，数月之前，楚莹还只是虚无境七阶，现在竟已是开元境五阶，进阶速度堪称神速。李老作为她的长辈，一脸欣慰。
“李老，你的修为也进步了啊。”楚莹微微额首，行了一礼，轻声道。
“呵呵，侥幸罢了。”李老微微一笑道，心中却是有些苦涩，自己的资质虽高，但和楚莹简直没法比，自己在凌空境九阶已停留了百年之久，数月前才通过服食丹药，突破到了元神境。以后修炼要想取得进步，更加艰难。
“哦？这位是？”看着楚莹身旁俊朗的少年，李老微微一奇。楚莹身旁跟着个天才少年他不会惊奇，但却跟这个普通的少年，不由暗自猜想着少年的身份。
“我朋友，我带他来登记。”楚莹解说道。

“对，对。我们是来登记的，赶紧办证吧。”岳雨随即说道，脸上挂着饱含深意的微笑。
“好的，我马上办理。”李老没有犹豫，便应道，随即转身向后堂走去。楚莹推荐的人，他不敢拒绝。即使对方是个四肢残废的人，李老都会毫不犹豫的答应，可见楚莹在宗门之内地位之高。
开阳宗招收外门弟子的标准极高。不但要拥有强大的实力，还要年轻，拥有好的资质，以及坚韧的毅力。所以，外门弟子无一不是难得一见的年轻天才，
此时，堂内已聚满了人，一些少年的目光颇为好奇的打量着岳雨。同时心中也是羡慕，能成为楚莹的朋友，得到的好处会很多。即使是一些堂主，都要给几分薄面。
岳雨却是不理会那些少年的目光，而是看着堂内的女弟子，心中一阵荡漾。每名女弟子都可谓都是年轻貌美，各有特色。有清纯型，奔放型，娇羞型，性感型……
岳雨此刻才觉得以前电视里的女明星根本称不上美丽二字，放在眼前古装美女的面前，简直就是庸俗丑陋。
暗自欣赏着每名女弟子，岳雨不由得看到了一张极其狂傲的脸，那目光轻浮，嚣张，不可一世。双手横抱于胸，一副老子很拽的样子，看的岳雨就想在他的脸上狠狠的踩上几脚，此人便是李狂那个傻B。
李狂穿着一件散发着金芒的华丽长袍，长袍上用金纹勾勒出一个狰狞的龙头，闪闪发光，气势威严。长袍上灵气浓郁，隐约间有缕缕七彩的气芒流转，可见他身上的金芒长袍显然不凡。
李狂感受着众女弟子投来狂热的眼神，便鼻孔朝天，悠然自得。
李狂前不久拜天霄峰长老狂烈为师，此长袍便是狂烈送给他的拜师礼物。乃是一件上等中品灵器，防御力强大，并且可以散发出强大的攻击，可谓是攻防并具，弥足珍贵。
灵器分为下品，中品，上品，极品四种。每种又分，下，中，上三等。
要想成为一名合格的炼器师，则需要强大的精神力，并且要身怀火，木两种灵根，精神力的感知力还要强。所以，要想成为炼器师，极其艰难。天灵界内，炼器师的数目便极其稀少，灵器便更是珍贵。
一件上等中品品灵器，就会引起诸多势力的抢夺。而上品灵器，就算是五大宗门都会尽力的去争夺。所以炼器师在天灵界的地位极高，每一名炼器师都是各大宗门重点招揽的对象。
像开阳宗这样的大宗门，炼器师的数目也只有十五名，所拥有的上品灵器也只有十多件。狂烈能将一件上等中品灵器赐给李狂，可见对其的重视。
此刻，李狂看着岳雨，一脸的不屑，冷眼瞥过，一道杀意闪过。想着自己的计划，嘴角便微微勾起，露出一抹淫荡的笑容。
“李兄，你为何这样看着我？难道你性趣向有问题？”见李狂一脸淫荡的看着自己，岳雨便故作胆怯的向后一退，一脸的恐慌，那样子就仿佛一名少女生怕被强了一般。
岳雨的话虽然不大，但堂内的众人又岂是普通人，所以他的话便清晰的落入了众人的耳中。同时，众弟子便向李狂望去，李狂脸上淫荡的笑容还并未散去，众人心中便猜疑了起来。
“难道他性取向真的有问题？”
“看那笑容，应该是。”
“那以后还是离他远些好了。”

堂内的少年低声议论着，李狂身旁的一些少年则是悄无声息的退到了远处，生怕李狂垂怜自己的帅气，而忍不住把自己给当众办了。
李狂则是一阵憋屈，淫荡得意的脸顿时变成了猪肝色。心中怒火升腾，双拳紧握，面部抽搐，显然气得不轻。若不是楚莹在岳雨身边，他早就上前将其碎尸万段，以泄心头之恨。
岳雨嘲弄的看了李狂一眼，不含声的说了句：“傻B.”
岳雨虽然并未出声，但李狂看着他的嘴形便能看出来说的什么，这几乎让他立刻暴走，不顾楚莹在场而上前将其斩杀。但他却不可能当着楚莹的面将岳雨斩杀，他没有那个实力，楚莹随时便能将他制止住。
压下心头的怒火，李狂冷冷的看了岳雨一眼，便向外走去，消失在众人的视线中。
“噗……”原本脸色淡然的楚莹顿时忍不住笑出了声。

Chapter 012 Shall we register? !
"You come with me, I will take you to register." After Chu Ying said that, she walked slowly outside the house.
"Let's go register?! Haha, okay." Yue Yu smiled obscenely and followed Chu Ying. The word registration made him think of registering a marriage. At the same time, he secretly sighed in his heart: "If anyone can marry her, they will definitely have a happy life in the future!"
Chu Ying couldn't figure out why Yue Yu had such a reaction, but looking at the obscene smile on his face, she knew that what he was thinking was not serious.
Following Chu Ying, Yue Yu used the detection technique on Chu Ying. After getting a new skill, Yue Yu naturally wanted to try it out.
bite! The opponent's level is too high and strength information cannot be detected.
The system voice sounded. Yue Yu was not surprised. Before, it was written on the skill that his current strength could only detect living creatures below level 30, which was below the spirit gathering realm. Chu Ying is a monk at the Kaiyuan level, so naturally she cannot detect it. "Let's try it on a low-level person later." Yue Yu thought to himself, leisurely admiring the surrounding scenery.
Soon, at the Kaiyang Zong Registration Hall, Yue Yu looked at the surrounding scenery with a look of wonder on his face. The building is magnificent, the surrounding spiritual grasses are colorful, the small bridges and flowing water are full of spiritual energy, and the scenery is poetic and picturesque, just like a fairyland on earth.
The elder's sermon ended not long ago. At this time, in front of the registration hall, there was a bustling crowd.
There are still many people coming on the bluestone road on the mountain peak, and there is an endless stream.
Kaiyang Sect, registration hall. It is the place where outer disciples register their identities, and it is also where the sect issues tasks. Thousands of disciples come every day.
At this time, the most eye-catching thing was that Yue Yu, an ordinary person, actually appeared in Kaiyang Sect, and he was accompanied by a genius disciple, Chu Ying. It was difficult not to attract attention.
Thousands of disciples looked at Yue Yu, with curiosity, disdain, disdain, and jealousy in their eyes... Yue Yu remembered the faces with each look deeply in his heart. Eyes are the windows of the soul. Yue Yu could clearly understand their character through their eyes.
Seeing Chu Ying's beautiful eyebrows furrowed slightly, a little displeased, all the disciples quickly looked away, looking as if nothing had happened.
Yue Yu ignored it and followed Chu Ying into the registration hall.
After seeing Chu Ying come in, an old man wearing green clothes, with a clear face, and exuding an invisible coercion came over. With a respectful expression, "Miss Chu, I haven't seen you for a long time. Your cultivation has improved a bit." The old man secretly marveled in his heart. A few months ago, Chu Ying was only at the seventh level of the Void Realm, but now she is already at the fifth level of the Kaiyuan Realm. The speed of advancement is extremely fast. As her elder, Mr. Li looked pleased.
"Mr. Li, your cultivation has also improved." Chu Ying bowed her head slightly and said softly.
"Haha, it's just a fluke." Mr. Li said with a slight smile, but he felt a little bitter in his heart. Although his qualifications were high, they were simply incomparable to Chu Ying. He had stayed at the ninth level of the Sky Realm for a hundred years, and he had only broken through to the Yuanshen Realm a few months ago by taking pills. It will be even more difficult to make progress in cultivation in the future.
"Oh? Who is this?" Looking at the handsome young man beside Chu Ying, Mr. Li was slightly surprised. He wouldn't be surprised to see a genius boy next to Chu Ying, but with this ordinary boy, he couldn't help but secretly guess the boy's identity.
"My friend, I brought him to register." Chu Ying explained.
"Yes, yes. We are here to register, so hurry up and apply for the certificate." Yue Yu said immediately, with a meaningful smile on his face.
"Okay, I'll handle it right away." Mr. Li responded without hesitation, then turned around and walked to the back hall. He did not dare to refuse anyone recommended by Chu Ying. Even if the other party is a disabled person, Mr. Li will agree without hesitation, which shows that Chu Ying has a high status within the sect.
Kaiyang Sect has extremely high standards for recruiting outer disciples. Not only must they have strong strength, but they must also be young and possess good qualifications.and perseverance. Therefore, all the outer disciples are rare young geniuses.
At this time, the hall was full of people, and some young people looked at Yue Yu curiously. At the same time, I was envious in my heart. Being able to become Chu Ying's friend would bring a lot of benefits. Even some hall masters have to give some thin noodles.
Yue Yu ignored the gazes of those young men, but looked at the female disciples in the hall, feeling a surge in his heart. Every female disciple can be said to be young and beautiful, with their own characteristics. There are pure type, unrestrained type, shy type, sexy type...
At this moment, Yue Yu felt that the female celebrities on TV in the past could not be called beautiful at all. When placed in front of the beautiful women in ancient costumes, they were simply vulgar and ugly.
Secretly admiring each female disciple, Yue Yu couldn't help but see an extremely arrogant face, with frivolous, arrogant and arrogant eyes. He held his hands across his chest, looking like he was pulling me hard. Yue Yu wanted to stomp on his face a few times. This person was that idiot Li Kuang.
Li Kuang was wearing a gorgeous robe that exuded golden light. A ferocious dragon head was outlined with gold patterns on the robe, which was sparkling and majestic. The aura on his robe is rich, and there are faint wisps of colorful aura flowing around. It can be seen that the golden robe on his body is obviously extraordinary.
Li Kuang felt the enthusiastic looks from the female disciples and turned his nostrils to the sky, feeling relaxed and content.
Not long ago, Li Kuang became a disciple of Kuang Lie, the elder of Tianxiao Peak, and this robe was Kuang Lie's gift to him as a disciple. It is a high-grade medium-grade spiritual weapon with strong defensive power and can emit powerful attacks. It can be said that it has both offense and defense, which is extremely precious.
There are four types of spiritual weapons: low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade, and top-grade. Each type is divided into three levels: lower, middle and upper.
If you want to become a qualified weapon refiner, you need strong spiritual power, and you must have two spiritual roots of fire and wood, and have a strong sense of spiritual power. Therefore, it is extremely difficult to become a weapon refiner. In the Tianling Realm, the number of weapon refiners is extremely rare, and spiritual weapons are even more precious.
A high-grade medium-grade spiritual weapon will cause many forces to rob it. As for high-grade spiritual weapons, even the five major sects will try their best to fight for them. Therefore, the status of weapon refiners in the Heavenly Spirit World is extremely high, and every weapon refiner is the target of recruitment by each major sect.
For a large sect like Kaiyang Sect, there are only fifteen weapon refiners and only a dozen or so high-grade spiritual weapons. Kuang Lie was able to bestow a high-grade medium-grade spiritual weapon on Li Kuang, which shows how much he values ​​him.
At this moment, Li Kuang looked at Yue Yu with disdain on his face, glanced at him coldly, and flashed with murderous intent. Thinking about his plan, the corners of his mouth were slightly raised, revealing a lustful smile.
"Brother Li, why are you looking at me like this? Is there something wrong with your sexual interest?" Seeing Li Kuang looking at him lustfully, Yue Yu pretended to be timid and stepped back with a look of panic, as if a girl was afraid of being raped.
Although Yue Yu's words were not loud, the people in the hall were not ordinary people, so his words clearly fell into the ears of everyone. At the same time, all the disciples looked at Li Kuang. The lewd smile on Li Kuang's face had not dissipated, and everyone became suspicious.
"Is there really something wrong with his sexual orientation?"
"Looking at that smile, it should be."
"Then it's better to stay away from him from now on."
The teenagers in the hall were talking in low voices, while some of the teenagers beside Li Kuang quietly retreated to a distance, for fear that Li Kuang would take pity on his handsomeness and could not help but do it to him in public.
Li Kuang felt aggrieved for a while, and his lustful and proud face suddenly turned the color of pig liver. Anger was rising in his heart, his fists were clenched, his face was twitching, it was obvious that he was very angry. If Chu Ying hadn't been by Yue Yu's side, he would have stepped forward and cut his body into thousands of pieces to vent his hatred.
Yue Yu glanced at Li Kuang mockingly and said silently: "Silly B."
Although Yue Yu didn't make a sound, Li Kuang looked at the shape of his mouthHe could tell what he was talking about, which almost made him go berserk immediately. He ignored Chu Ying's presence and stepped forward to kill her. But it was impossible for him to kill Yue Yu in front of Chu Ying. He didn't have the strength, and Chu Ying could stop him at any time.
Suppressing the anger in his heart, Li Kuang gave Yue Yu a cold look, then walked out and disappeared from everyone's sight.
"Pfft..." Chu Ying, who had a calm face at first, couldn't help laughing.
